name: l1000_imputation_fidelity
claim: Per-gene-class Spearman agreement between L1000 and Tahoe deltas on 32 shared (cell line, drug) pairs, 7 lines x 19 drugs at 24h. Landmark genes -- measured on both platforms and therefore the positive control -- reach mean rho 0.041 against a mismatched-pair null at p=0.2438, so absolute cross-platform agreement is NOT established and the test is underpowered for absolute claims.
